<task>
Production incident with evidence released in 3 stages over time.
Read-only files are under /task/fixtures. Stage 1 is available now:
  stage-1/UPDATE.md (4 lines)
  stage-1/config/payments-api.yaml (14 lines)
  stage-1/deploy/deploys.log (7 lines)
  stage-1/deploy/release-notes-5.36.1-f33d.md (23 lines)
  stage-1/logs/ingress-a.log (433 lines)
  stage-1/logs/payments-api.log (862 lines)
  stage-1/ops/oncall-notes.md (6 lines)

Staged evidence:
- Reply {"action": "advance"} to release the next stage when you are ready. Its files appear
  under /task/fixtures/stage-N/ and an update message is added to your working context.
  Released files never change and stay readable for the rest of the task.
- A final answer is accepted only after all 3 stages are released.

Rules of evidence:
- Build release notes describe defaults shipped in a build; they override repository config files.
- Records marked APPLIED in change logs are authoritative and supersede release-note defaults,
  config files and earlier notes. If two authoritative records conflict, the later wins.
- PROPOSED records were not applied. On-call notes are informal and may be out of date.
- Earlier hypotheses may be superseded by later evidence; diagnose the incident as it stands at
  the end of the final stage.

Answer fields (all required):
- root_cause: start with exactly one cause code, then a colon and a one-sentence explanation.
- required_value: the exact current effective value of the setting at the centre of the root
  cause at the end of the final stage.
- remedy: start with exactly one remedy code, then a colon and a concrete action.
- evidence_refs: list of "path:line" or "path:start-end" references (paths relative to
  /task/fixtures, 1-based, ranges of at most 20 lines) supporting (1) the current symptom,
  (2) the record that sets the current effective value, and (3) the record of the change that
  originally introduced the problem.

Cause codes:
  DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED: database connection pool too small for load
  TLS_CERT_EXPIRED: an expired TLS certificate is being served or presented
  CLIENT_TIMEOUT_TOO_LOW: a client timeout is lower than the upstream's normal latency
  FEATURE_FLAG_REGRESSION: a feature flag rollout enabled faulty code
  DISK_FULL: a volume ran out of space
  DNS_RESOLUTION_FAILURE: service discovery / DNS records are wrong or failing
  MEMORY_LIMIT_OOM: processes are killed for exceeding memory limits
  UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMITED: an upstream is rejecting calls due to rate limits
Remedy codes:
  RAISE_DB_POOL_LIMIT: raise the connection pool limit to cover demand
  ROTATE_CERTIFICATE: deploy a valid, unexpired certificate
  RAISE_CLIENT_TIMEOUT: raise the client timeout above upstream latency
  DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAG: turn the faulty feature flag off
  EXPAND_VOLUME: free or expand the full volume
  FIX_DNS_RECORD: correct the DNS / discovery record
  RAISE_MEMORY_LIMIT: raise the memory limit or fix the leak
  REQUEST_RATE_LIMIT_INCREASE: reduce call rate or obtain a higher quota
</task>

<transcript_to_summarise>
{"id": "sum3", "role": "summary", "body": "Summary of work so far (stage 2 of 3 released; stage 2 files NOT yet read)

Stage 1 findings (all under /task/fixtures/stage-1/):
- UPDATE.md:1-4: covers 08:00-09:30 UTC. ingress-a started returning 5xx for payments-api shortly after a deploy.
- config/payments-api.yaml is the repo default and is overridden by release notes and APPLIED records:
  - line 6: risk-score base_url http://risk-score.internal
  - line 7: clients.risk-score.timeout_ms: 2500
  - line 9: db host payments-api-db.internal
  - line 11: database.pool.max_size: 60
  - line 12: acquire_timeout_ms: 5000
  - line 14: cache.ttl_s: 120
- deploy/deploys.log:4: 2031-04-14T08:18:43Z DEPLOY payments-api build 5.36.1-f33d (previous 5.35.4), rollout 100%, by deploy-bot. Other deploys are unrelated (shipping-api, billing-svc, orders-api, inventory-svc, quotes-api).
- deploy/release-notes-5.36.1-f33d.md (overrides repo config):
  - line 13: default clients.risk-score.timeout_ms lowered 2500 -> 800 ("fail fast").
  - line 16: default db.pool.max_size lowered 60 -> 14 "to fit the shared-db connection quota".
  - line 9: ff-legacy-export removed (was 0%).
  - Other entries are benign.
- ops/oncall-notes.md (informal):
  - line 5: at 08:33, 5xx and risk-score timeouts.
  - line 6: at 08:43, suspects the timeout change.
- logs/payments-api.log:
  - Only error type is "ERROR payments-api [payments-api-<pod>] upstream call risk-score timed out after Nms (attempt...)".
  - First seen at line 179 (41 occurrences, pod d*), line 191 (29, pod e*), line 222 (25, pod a*).
  - No DB pool errors in stage 1.
  - Background noise, all ruled out: gc pauses 135-256ms, dns cache refresh retry succeeded (line 7), TLS cert expires in 27 days (line 8), disk /var/data 67% (line 25).
- stage-1 ingress-a.log has not been inspected (its 5xx format differs).
- Notes are kept in /task/workspace/notes.txt.

Stage 2 (09:30-10:30 UTC), from the advance message:
- On-call applied a mitigation recorded in stage-2/deploy/changes.log; this is likely an APPLIED timeout raise.
- The risk-score timeouts stopped, but ingress-a still returns 503s for payments-api with a different error.
- New files (none read yet):
  - stage-2/UPDATE.md (4 lines)
  - stage-2/deploy/changes.log (2 lines)
  - stage-2/logs/ingress-a.log (420 lines)
  - stage-2/logs/payments-api.log (910 lines)
  - stage-2/metrics/payments-api.csv (61 lines)
  - stage-2/ops/oncall-notes.md (6 lines)

Hypotheses:
- The stage-1 CLIENT_TIMEOUT_TOO_LOW cause was likely mitigated in stage 2, so it is probably superseded.
- New leading suspect: DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED. Release notes line 16 set pool max_size to 14, which would surface once timeouts no longer fail fast.
- To confirm: look for pool/acquire errors in stage-2 payments-api.log and pool metrics in the csv.

Next steps:
1. Read stage-2 UPDATE.md, changes.log (note APPLIED vs PROPOSED, exact values and lines), oncall-notes, and grep payments-api.log and ingress-a.log for ERROR/503 with line numbers; check the csv.
2. Advance to stage 3. Look for APPLIED or PROPOSED changes to pool max_size or timeout. The later APPLIED record wins; PROPOSED records are ignored.
3. Final answer evidence_refs need three parts:
   - symptom: a latest-stage log range of at most 20 lines;
   - the record setting the current effective value;
   - the originating change: stage-1/deploy/release-notes-5.36.1-f33d.md:16 if the cause is DB, or :13 if it is the timeout."}
